proposal.subject: practical-ai
proposal.title: AI-Enhanced Customer Email Drafting
proposal.outcome: Draft customer emails with AI and check them against supplied facts.
proposal.reason: This plan builds your confidence in drafting clear, professional customer emails with AI support, covering prompt creation, iterative refinement, and data safety. It is ideal for beginners wanting to improve communication efficiency and accuracy.
proposal.goalEvidence: Use AI to write clearer customer emails
proposal.context: Imagine you are a customer support representative at a SaaS startup, fielding hundreds of daily queries. Your goal is to reply swiftly yet clearly, using AI to craft concise, helpful emails that reflect your brand voice.

modules.introduction: Begin by exploring how AI tools can assist with email drafting, recognizing their strengths and the boundaries they present. This foundation will guide your prompt creation and iteration skills.
Learn techniques to formulate precise prompts that yield clear, relevant responses from AI. Focus on specifying tone, audience, and key information for effective email drafts.
Practice refining AI-generated drafts by providing feedback and making incremental edits. This iterative cycle helps produce polished, customer‑friendly messages.
Understand how to check AI outputs for accuracy and maintain confidentiality, ensuring that sensitive details are handled appropriately in your communications.
